title: Protesting Crowd, Climate Strike, Guildford, 01-01.wav by InspectorJ
author: InspectorJ
sourceDescription: Today begins a week of immense global protests and strikes to bring attention to the climate issue. Of course, I attended the Guildford protest, participated and documented it here with some of its vocal chanting from a crowd of several hundred. With the aim of spreading news of this strike as much as possible, I am releasing this sound to the public domain. These strikes deserve to be heard. They need to be heard.
